about: Havells India Limited, a fast-moving electrical and electronic durables company, manufactures, trades in, and sells various consumer electrical and electronic products in India and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Switchgears, Cables, Lighting and Fixtures, Electrical Consumer Durables, Lloyd Consumer, and Others.
